Is tirzepatide better than semaglutide?

In the SURMOUNT-5 trial, tirzepatide gave about 20% weight loss versus about 14% with semaglutide at 72 weeks. Both are approved medicines, and the choice is for you and your doctor. Sema or tirz? One word.
